description: This file contains functions for manipulating protobuf message options, including enabling or disabling specific features via extensions, and is part of the gogo/protobuf vanity package.

methods.name: MessageHasBoolExtension
methods.description: Checks if a protobuf message has a specific boolean extension.

methods.name: SetBoolMessageOption
methods.description: Returns a function that sets a boolean extension option on a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOffGoGetters
methods.description: Disables Go getters for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOffGoStringer
methods.description: Disables Go Stringer for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnVerboseEqual
methods.description: Enables verbose equality comparison for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnFace
methods.description: Enables face (probably a feature flag) for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnGoString
methods.description: Enables Go Stringer for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnPopulate
methods.description: Enables populate feature for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnStringer
methods.description: Enables Stringer for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnEqual
methods.description: Enables equality comparison for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnDescription
methods.description: Enables description feature for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnTestGen
methods.description: Enables test code generation for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnBenchGen
methods.description: Enables benchmark code generation for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnMarshaler
methods.description: Enables marshaler for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnUnmarshaler
methods.description: Enables unmarshaler for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnSizer
methods.description: Enables size calculation for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnUnsafeUnmarshaler
methods.description: Enables unsafe unmarshaler for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnUnsafeMarshaler
methods.description: Enables unsafe marshaler for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOffGoExtensionsMap
methods.description: Disables extensions map for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOffGoUnrecognized
methods.description: Disables unrecognized fields for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOffGoUnkeyed
methods.description: Disables unkeyed fields for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOffGoSizecache
methods.description: Disables size cache for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnCompare
methods.description: Enables compare feature for a protobuf message.

methods.name: TurnOnMessageName
methods.description: Enables message name feature for a protobuf message.
